content: Thanks. I think it's been a 404 for months, I am working on completely rewriting everything in Verso and the old docs were nothing like a proof of FLT, they were a proof of finite-dimensionality of a space of automorphic forms, something which I am strongly considering removing from the final FLT output. I would be quite happy for the status to be "the blueprint does not exist yet". It only ever existed because people were pressuring me to "start" when I wasn't remotely ready.
